lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 6 distinct vertical white lines traversing the torso; spacing is non-uniform, ranging from approximately 8% to 15% of the torso's horizontal pixel width.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most vertical line and the fourth line from the anterior are abbreviated, terminating before crossing the mid-line of the ventral torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two isolated high-contrast white spots are visible on the upper posterior thigh/haunch area.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate-shaped spirals with an initial outward lateral trajectory followed by a medial/inward terminal curve; approx. 45-degree angle from the frontal bone.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Approximately 1.3:1 ratio of the distance between terminal tips compared to the total width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Ivory tipping accounts for approximately 12-15% of the total vertical pixel length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white pixel clusters (spots) on the cheek and a partially visible white chevron on the bridge of the muzzle; high-contrast white 'stocking' markings present on the lower limbs above the hooves.
